    About Me

    I’m Oliver. I’m a researcher and designer who delivers design research. I bring design to complex social change and sustainability projects that involve tech, policy, services and systems. I use creative and diy methods, games and facilitation in my work, and talk software and data.

    I currently do a patchwork of things between consultancy, academia and DIY:

    • 👩‍🎤 Lancaster University - research fellow. sustainable futures and digital research infrastructure
    • 🌀 fractals.coop - co-owner/worker, leading UCD and service evaluation consultancy, creative facilitation, climate futures conversations
    • 📊 Cetis LLP - partner, edutech, data analysis, viz, carbon data

    You can find my work in a bunch of different places:

    • 👾 itch.io - my games, zines and diy stuff
    • ⚙️ Crank and File - gig economy cycle courier provocations and futures
    • 🫖 Manky Tea Towel Museum - contribute your tea towels to the Manky Tea Towel Museum
    • 🖥️ GitHub - a chaotic archive of code
    • 📜 Google Scholar - academic outputs
